jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Overview

Project Coordinator

Location: San Francisco, CA

HGA is seeking a dynamic and driven Project Coordinator
to join our San Francisco, CA Interior Design team. We’re looking for someone with exceptional communication, presentation, time‑management, and interpersonal skills—someone who thrives in a collaborative setting and is passionate about elevating design.

In this role, you’ll partner closely with Interior Designers, Project Architects, and Project Managers to help shape innovative, technically sound design solutions. You’ll contribute to the development of detailed project documentation while upholding our firm’s commitment to design excellence and outstanding client service.

What You’ll Do

Partner on the development of construction documents and ensure design intent is accurately carried through.
Translate complex project goals into creative and functional design solutions.
Collaborate across disciplines to coordinate architectural and engineering systems.
Participate in client meetings and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders.
Partner to meet critical project milestones and deadlines maintaining a high level of attention to detail and quality.

In This Role You Will

Develop a thorough understanding of projects’ design philosophy and provide major input in developing a design and building performance strategy, effectively conveying this to assigned team members when appropriate.
Provide technical design input and support for the development of the entire design concept.
Coordinate the project’s technical design effort, subsequent detailed design development, project coordination and quality control efforts during all phases of project work, in close collaboration with an Interior Designer, Project Architect, Senior Designer and Project Manager.
Seek creative and innovative solutions to assigned tasks and develop appropriate research and documents to support these solutions.
Actively collaborate with and coordinate work of consultants and knowledge resources to ensure the project deliverables are coordinated, integrated and support the design concept and performance goals of the project.
Contribute to the preparation of design documents and leads the detailed development of construction documents during all project phases, delivering complete, accurate and coordinated project documentation.
Advance the production of schematic, design development and construction document drawings and specifications in compliance with project scope, schedule, cost and design intent.
Review and coordinate project documents with relevant Building Codes, City Planning/Zoning ordinances and similar requirements for Authorities Having Jurisdiction.
Maintain awareness of evolving building technology and systems.
Review shop drawings, material samples and Construction Documents for conformance with design.
Perform construction administration duties (e.g., RFI’s, RFP’s, change orders, etc.).
Maintain contact with clients, consultants and contractors during all project phases, participating in marketing, client and owner presentations as required.

What You Will Need To Have

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree from an accredited Interior Design/Interior Architecture program or related field
5 to 7 years of experience working on small- to large-scale project types
Experience with TI and core and shell
Strong graphic skills
Revit knowledge and experience required
Knowledge of AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp and other industry accepted software as well as expertise with project management software and Microsoft Office Suite products is needed
Ability to travel to job sites

Salary Information

The pay range listed aligns to the geography of the office for which this position is posted. Actual compensation will be based upon work experience, education, licensure requirements and/or skill level and will be finalized at the time of offer. Individuals in this role working more than 24 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in HGA’s robust benefit programs which include an annual bonus and success sharing bonus program, 401(k) guaranteed contribution, paid parental leave, medical, dental and life insurance plans as well as PTO and short- and long-term disability programs. Salary Range: $85,000 - $96,000 depending on qualifications and experience
.

Additional Information

HGA is a place where you can do your best work. We believe that enduring, impactful design results from deep insight into the people and passions that animate each unique environment. We value empathy, are fueled by curiosity, and embrace the hard work that leads to innovation. Equally important is our commitment to creating a culture of inclusivity and diversity where we encourage your originality, respect the need for flexibility and work-life balance, and empower your desired career growth. HGA is a national award-winning interdisciplinary design firm rooted in architecture and engineering.

Learn more about us here
.

Application Requirements & Instructions

Please submit resume and portfolio for consideration.

jobs.description:
Job Title:
Data Analyst

Industry:
Manufacturing

Location:
Corning, NY

Shift:
8am to 5pm, Monday through Friday, fully onsite

Interview Process:
First round is a video interview, second round is onsite

Client Overview

This opportunity is with a global leader in materials science and advanced technology manufacturing, supporting a major innovation program within one of its research and development campuses. The team you would join works at the intersection of engineering, program management, and data, helping guide decisions on new product and technology development. This is a well established, well resourced organization with a long track record of investing in innovation.

Top 3 Skills

Business intelligence and dashboard development
Data quality management and governance
Data analysis and reporting for cross functional stakeholders

What You'll Do

Support data capture processes to keep program data timely, accurate, and consistent
Monitor and validate data quality, identifying and resolving discrepancies
Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and performance metrics
Work with program stakeholders to translate business needs into analytical solutions
Analyze data to surface trends, risks, and opportunities that support program goals
Maintain documentation for data definitions and reporting methodologies
Recommend improvements to data collection and reporting processes
Partner with technical and business teams to ensure data accessibility and integrity

What We Need From You

Associate's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Analytics, or a related field, Bachelor's preferred
1 to 5 years of experience in data analysis, data quality management, and dashboard development
Proficiency in at least one business intelligence or analytics platform such as Power BI, Tableau, or JMP or Python
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including presenting findings to both technical and non technical audiences
Must be local to the Corning, NY area

Preferred / Bonus

Bachelor's degree in a related field
Experience with Power BI specifically
Experience with Tableau specifically
Experience with JMP or Python specifically
Experience supporting R&D, innovation, product development, or technology programs
Familiarity with KPI development and performance reporting frameworks
Experience working in cross functional environments spanning engineering, business, and program management

About Elevait

Elevait Solutions was founded by veterans who believe that how you treat people is the only thing that actually matters in this industry. We're a team that stays in your corner before, during, and after placement. We show up for the communities we work in, we tell you the truth, and we work hard to make sure every placement is a good fit for both sides. If that sounds like the kind of team you want behind you, we'd like to talk.

Elevait is a certified Service Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business (SDVOSB). We have over 100,000 LinkedIn followers, and Elevait was named a top company for hiring veterans by U.S. Veterans Magazine. We would rather you check us out yourself than just take our word for it, so look us up on our website and on LinkedIn.

Pay Transparency

New York requires pay range disclosure for this posting. The pay range for this position is $23.41 to $29.00 per hour, based on qualifications and experience.

Job Posting ID

CRNGJP00030004

Buzzwords

analytics, dashboards, reporting, visualization, governance, quality, insights, metrics, statistics, data, BI, KPI

Top 3 LinkedIn Job Titles

Data Analyst
Business Intelligence Analyst
Reporting Analyst

Internal Market Recap
(client: Corning Incorporated, Sullivan Park campus, Painted Post/Corning NY)

Pay Positioning
Max bill rate on this req is $42.87/hr, and the candidate-facing rate given is up to $29/hr, near the top of Magnit's own suggested $23.41 to $28.58 range (actually slightly above it at $29). For a Data Analyst 2 role of this scope (BI tools, dashboarding, cross functional support, 1 to 5 years experience) in the Corning/Elmira, NY market, this lands roughly in line with the median to slightly above for similar analyst roles in upstate NY. It is not a rate that will struggle badly, but it is not a standout either. If you're struggling to find qualified people at this rate, here's what to consider loosening: move the specific tool preference (Power BI vs. Tableau vs. JMP/Python) fully to "proficiency in at least one" rather than expecting multiple, and consider relaxing the years of experience floor toward the lower end of the 1 to 5 range before touching anything in Top 3 Skills.

Competitive Landscape
Local/regional talent pool around Corning and Elmira, NY: Corning Incorporated itself (other divisions), IEC Electronics, Hilliard Corporation, Willow Run Foods, Guthrie Clinic (data/analytics roles), Elmira Savings Bank, Chemung Financial Corporation, Watson Homes. Broader upstate NY/regional peer employers doing similar data analyst work: Corning's own competitors in materials science and advanced manufacturing such as 3M, Owens Corning, and Saint Gobain, plus general BI/data analyst employers in the Rochester/Syracuse corridor like Paychex, Excellus BlueCross BlueShield, and Wegmans.

Contractor vs. FTE Trends
No client specific Contract to FTE pattern on file yet for Corning. Using the general heuristic: most Elevait contract engagements carry a strong track record of extending and converting toward full time, though nothing is guaranteed. This req runs roughly a full year (09/14/2026 to 08/27/2027), which is a long initial term and suggests a legitimate ongoing need rather than a short term project, so frame it with the candidate as a contract with a real trajectory toward extension or conversion, not a hard stop at the end date.

Selling Points & Watch-Outs
Selling points: this is a well funded innovation program at a large, established materials science company, giving the analyst visibility into R&D decision making rather than routine back office reporting. The role offers exposure to multiple BI tools rather than being locked into one platform. Long contract duration signals stability. Watch-outs: fully onsite, five days a week, with no remote flexibility, which will be a dealbreaker for some candidates. Local candidates only, so this will not work for anyone needing relocation. Shortlisting is happening fast, candidates need to be ready to move by Friday, August 14 in the afternoon.

Candidate Profile
Realistic candidate has an Associate's or Bachelor's degree in a data, analytics, or business related field, 1 to 5 years of hands on experience building dashboards and reports, and is currently working as a data analyst, BI analyst, or reporting analyst, likely in a manufacturing, corporate, or R&D support function. They are comfortable presenting findings to non technical stakeholders and are not necessarily a heavy coder, more tool proficient than a data scientist.

Sourcing Channels
Source on LinkedIn Recruiter using zip code plus radius around Corning, NY 14831 rather than city name stacking given the smaller local market. Target BI and reporting analyst profiles at the competitive landscape companies above, especially Corning's other divisions and regional manufacturing or healthcare employers with analytics teams. Also check general Data Analyst and Business Intelligence Analyst searches restricted to the Elmira, Corning, and greater Southern Tier NY area, since the local pool is small and this role does not require a niche technical background.

LinkedIn Location Coverage
(anchor: Corning, NY 14831)

Corning sits in New York's Southern Tier, about 20 to 25 minutes west of Elmira along Route 17/I-86, which is the main east-west corridor through this part of the state. The area is rural and small-town in character, with towns strung along the river valley and connected primarily by I-86/Route 17 and a scattering of state routes, so most nearby places are reachable within an hour along this one corridor rather than a dense highway grid.

jobs.description:
Job Overview:

Job Title: Sr. Financial Data Analyst, Corporate FP&A

This role is specific to the current Coffee Operating Unit of KDP.  Following the recent, successful acquisition of JDE Peet’s in April 2026, the Coffee Operating Unit will become its own independent publicly traded company.  For more information on this, please visit keurigdrpepper.com  Summary:

Keurig Dr Pepper is seeking a hands-on, experienced Sr. Financial Data Analyst to join its Corporate FP&A team. This role is ideal for a finance professional who thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment and is motivated by the opportunity to expand their influence across the organization while growing personally and professionally. The position requires a process-oriented leader who can partner effectively with the financial management team to provide decision support, identify savings opportunities, and improve productivity across the organization.

Role Overview:

As a Sr. Financial Data Analyst, you will be responsible for interpreting complex financial data, creating insightful reports, reconciling systems, driving process improvements, supporting the Financial Product Owner in financial data product development, and communicating effectively with stakeholders across the business.

Key Responsibilities:

Data Interpretation and Modeling Support

Perform ad hoc projects and analyses using varied and complex datasets.
Develop financial models and analyses using advanced analytical tools and multiple reporting systems; provide accessible insights, projections, and decision-support materials with appropriate guidance.
Drive financial process improvements related to information management, model governance, and reporting efficiency.
Maintain complex information models and support end users with financial data extraction, reporting, and analysis.

System and Financial Reconciliation

Collect, clean, and organize financial data from various sources, including databases and enterprise reporting systems.
Reconcile detailed datasets across multiple source systems using independently developed models and validation processes.
Troubleshoot system inconsistencies and partner with IT and operational stakeholders to resolve discrepancies.

Project Management and Stakeholder Communication

Partner with cross-functional teams to lead financial planning and reporting system integration efforts across the global Coffee organization.
Partner with the Product Owner to define product strategy, prioritize business value, and support the delivery of new financial data capabilities.
Participate in Agile ways of working and support cross-functional collaboration throughout development cycles.
Prepare comprehensive reports and dashboards that communicate key findings, insights, and recommendations to stakeholders. Use data visualization tools to present complex information clearly and concisely.
Gather business and development requirements and translate them into actionable product roadmap items.
Create compelling, visually engaging PowerPoint presentations that translate complex data, insights, and strategic recommendations into clear executive-ready narratives.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

Total Rewards:

Salary Range: $76,400 - $ 100,000
Actual placement within the compensation range may vary depending on experience, skills, and other factors
Benefits, subject to election and eligibility: Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, Paid Time Off (including paid parental leave, vacation, and sick time), 401k with company match, Tuition Reimbursement, and Mileage Reimbursement
Annual bonus based on performance and eligibility

Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Data Analytics, or a related field;
2+ years of experience in financial analysis, data analytics, problem-solving, or analytical decision support.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint required.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively while managing multiple priorities and parallel workstreams.

Company Overview:

Keurig Dr Pepper (Nasdaq: KDP) is a leading beverage company with more than 150 owned, licensed and partner brands that meet a wide range of needs and occasions. Our North American refreshment beverage business holds leadership positions across carbonated soft drinks, water, juice and mixers with a portfolio of iconic brands such as Dr Pepper®, Canada Dry®, Mott’s®, A&W®, Peñafiel®, GHOST®, 7UP®, Snapple®, Clamato® and Core Hydration®. Our global coffee business spans more than 100 markets and includes the leading Keurig® single-serve brewing system in the U.S. and Canada, along with powerhouse brands such as Peet’s, L’OR and Jacobs, and other regional coffee leaders. Our more than 50,000 employees aim to enhance the experience of every beverage and coffee occasion while making a positive impact for people, communities, and the planet.

We strive to be an employer of choice, providing culture and opportunities that empower our team to grow and develop. We offer robust benefits to support your health and wellness as well as your personal and financial well-being. We also provide employee programs designed to enhance your professional growth and development, while ensuring you feel valued, inspired and appreciated at work.

Whatever your area of expertise, at KDP you can be a part of a team that’s proud of its brands, partnerships, innovation and growth. Will you join us?

The Principal Data Analyst will leverage deep expertise in Medicaid programs, claims processing, eligibility, provider data, and CMS reporting requirements to support business and technical decision-making, ensure compliance, and deliver actionable analytics and data solutions.

jobs.title: Website Content Creator and Communications Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Systems Engineering Research Center (SERC) seeks an individual with versatile technical and creative skills for a dual role on its communications team.

SERC is a university affiliated research center (UARC) of the United States Department of War, headquartered at Stevens Institute of Technology and including faculty researchers at more than 25 universities nationwide.

Qualifications, Responsibilities, And Organizational Culture

With 5+ years of experience, the ideal candidate has expertise for creating and editing WordPress pages on the SERC website to elevate the site's visual appeal, organization of information, and user experience. Basic graphic design experience is required with programs like Photoshop and Canva. A related task involves uploading reports and updating information on the SERC research database.
This dual role also calls for an ability to access, organize, analyze, and present website data from Google Analytics. The ideal candidate will have a sense of how communication integrates with and evolves through technology and can analyze data to contribute ideas and strategies.
SERC uses AI tools but holds human judgement at the top. The ideal candidate should know how to use AI as a guide, or to save time on basic tasks, but will retain a keen eye for oversight.
Accuracy is essential for names, titles, technical terms, and other details. Periodically, projects require quick action on new priority directives.
An exceptional candidate will have experience running virtual events on Zoom, as well as familiarity with Amazon Web Services.
The SERC team is diverse in numerous ways. The ideal candidate must be comfortable interacting with a mosaic of skill sets. Many interactions will be virtual due to the team's national reach. This role is open to the best candidate wherever they live, though being able to commute to the SERC office in Hoboken, NJ, is a plus. This role may require periodic travel for SERC events in the Washington, DC area or to other locales.

How To Apply

To apply, please submit a resume, a self-written cover letter, and at least three examples of technical and/or creative work (professional or personal) accessible online.

jobs.description:
Job Summary

Galapagos Federal Systems, LLC is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Data Analyst to join our team at Patrick Space Force Base, Florida. This position offers an exciting opportunity to support the Space Training and Readiness Command (STARCOM) by providing data analysis, reporting, and visualizations to improve operational effectiveness, and support mission success.

The Data Analyst will collect, analyze, and interpret data from multiple enterprise systems to develop workforce analysis, and support enterprise decisions making. The successful candidate will develop reports, dashboards, and data visualizations that provide meaningful insights to government stakeholders. This role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate technical information effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Key Responsibilities

The Data Analyst will

Develop and continuously enhance STARCOM's workforce analytics capabilities, providing timely, accurate, and actionable insights to support strategic decision-making
Analyze workforce, operational, and organizational data to identify trends, measure performance, and support planning efforts
Develop, maintain, and enhance executive dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using data from multiple enterprise systems
Design and implement automated reporting solutions, databases, and analytics tools to improve efficiency and data accessibility
Identify workforce trends, hiring metrics, readiness indicators, and organizational performance measures to inform leadership decisions
Collaborate with government stakeholders to gather requirements and develop reporting and analytical solutions
Respond to leadership and stakeholder requests by preparing timely, accurate reports, dashboards, and analytical products
Validate, integrate, cleanse, and standardize data from multiple sources to ensure data quality and consistency
Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes and recommend enhancements that increase efficiency
Prepare reports, presentations, and data visualizations that communicate analytical findings to technical and non-technical audiences
Develop predictive models and trend analyses to support workforce planning, forecasting, and data-driven decision-making

Skills And Experience

The Data Analyst must have

Active Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) security clearance
5+ years of experience supporting Department of Defense (DoD) organizations in data analytics, business intelligence, workforce analytics, or a related field
Demonstrated experience collecting, integrating, cleansing, validating, and analyzing large datasets from multiple enterprise systems
Experience developing executive dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using Microsoft Power BI, Power Apps, Excel, or similar business intelligence tools
Experience analyzing business processes, workforce data, and operational metrics to deliver actionable insights and recommendations
Experience collaborating with stakeholders to gather business requirements and develop data-driven analytical solutions
Experience implementing predictive analytics, forecasting models, and trend analysis to support strategic planning and organizational decision-making
Strong understanding of data quality management, governance, and data validation best practices
Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, mission-focused environment

Education and Certifications

The Data Analyst must meet the following

Required

Bachelor of Art (BA) or Bachelor of Science (BS)
Equivalent work experience may be considered in lieu of education

Benefits

Medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance
Flexible Spending Accounts
401(k)
PTO

SERC uses AI tools but holds human judgement at the top. The ideal candidate should know how to use AI as a guide, or to save time on basic tasks, but will retain a keen eye for oversight.
Accuracy is essential for names, titles, technical terms, and other details. Periodically, projects require quick action on new priority directives.
An exceptional candidate will have experience running virtual events on Zoom, as well as familiarity with Amazon Web Services.
The SERC team is diverse in numerous ways. The ideal candidate must be comfortable interacting with a mosaic of skill sets. Many interactions will be virtual due to the team's national reach. This role is open to the best candidate wherever they live, though being able to commute to the SERC office in Hoboken, NJ, is a plus. This role may require periodic travel for SERC events in the Washington, DC area or to other locales.

How To Apply

To apply, please submit a resume, a self-written cover letter, and at least three examples of technical and/or creative work (professional or personal) accessible online.

new_jobs.title: Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Job Summary

Galapagos Federal Systems, LLC is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Data Analyst to join our team at Patrick Space Force Base, Florida. This position offers an exciting opportunity to support the Space Training and Readiness Command (STARCOM) by providing data analysis, reporting, and visualizations to improve operational effectiveness, and support mission success.

The Data Analyst will collect, analyze, and interpret data from multiple enterprise systems to develop workforce analysis, and support enterprise decisions making. The successful candidate will develop reports, dashboards, and data visualizations that provide meaningful insights to government stakeholders. This role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate technical information effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Key Responsibilities

The Data Analyst will

Develop and continuously enhance STARCOM's workforce analytics capabilities, providing timely, accurate, and actionable insights to support strategic decision-making
Analyze workforce, operational, and organizational data to identify trends, measure performance, and support planning efforts
Develop, maintain, and enhance executive dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using data from multiple enterprise systems
Design and implement automated reporting solutions, databases, and analytics tools to improve efficiency and data accessibility
Identify workforce trends, hiring metrics, readiness indicators, and organizational performance measures to inform leadership decisions
Collaborate with government stakeholders to gather requirements and develop reporting and analytical solutions
Respond to leadership and stakeholder requests by preparing timely, accurate reports, dashboards, and analytical products
Validate, integrate, cleanse, and standardize data from multiple sources to ensure data quality and consistency
Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes and recommend enhancements that increase efficiency
Prepare reports, presentations, and data visualizations that communicate analytical findings to technical and non-technical audiences
Develop predictive models and trend analyses to support workforce planning, forecasting, and data-driven decision-making

Skills And Experience

The Data Analyst must have

Active Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) security clearance
5+ years of experience supporting Department of Defense (DoD) organizations in data analytics, business intelligence, workforce analytics, or a related field
Demonstrated experience collecting, integrating, cleansing, validating, and analyzing large datasets from multiple enterprise systems
Experience developing executive dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using Microsoft Power BI, Power Apps, Excel, or similar business intelligence tools
Experience analyzing business processes, workforce data, and operational metrics to deliver actionable insights and recommendations
Experience collaborating with stakeholders to gather business requirements and develop data-driven analytical solutions
Experience implementing predictive analytics, forecasting models, and trend analysis to support strategic planning and organizational decision-making
Strong understanding of data quality management, governance, and data validation best practices
Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, mission-focused environment

Education and Certifications

The Data Analyst must meet the following

Required

Bachelor of Art (BA) or Bachelor of Science (BS)
Equivalent work experience may be considered in lieu of education

Benefits

Medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance
Flexible Spending Accounts
401(k)
PTO
Paid Paternal leave
Tuition reimbursement
Paid federal holidays

Security Clearance

Must be a U.S. Citizen. A high-level Department of Defense active security clearance is/may be required. Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to government information.

Physical Requirements

Work may involve sitting or standing for extended periods of time and typing and reading from a computer screen. The candidate must have enough mobility, including bending, reaching, and kneeling, to complete daily duties in a prompt and efficient manner, and that may include lifting up to thirty pounds, as necessary.

Company Summary

Headquartered in Hawaii, Galapagos Federal Systems, LLC, is an SBA-Certified NHO-owned 8(a) Small Business specializing in global information technology solutions. We deliver professional services in IT Design & Installation, Cybersecurity Engineering & Support, Application Integration & Development, Software & Hardware Engineering, Network & Systems Management, Information Systems Security, and Business Management Services.

Leveraging over 30 years of providing IT services to the federal & commercial market with projects found around the world, our team has innovative expertise in the development of a wide range of technological solutions. Galapagos Federal Systems, LLC is an equal opportunity employer.

Our service commitment is simple - "Quality IT Solutions... On Time & On Budget."

Company Employment Statement

Galapagos Federal Systems, LLC reserves the right to change or modify job duties and assignments at any time. Andersen Corporation Summary

At Andersen, we see possibility everywhere, every day and in everything we do. The possibility for our employees to achieve their full potential, for our communities to be stronger and for everyone to have a healthier, happier place to live.

Our portfolio of brands — Andersen Windows & Doors, Renewal by Andersen and Fenetres MQ — is crafted to serve customers across the new residential, home improvement and light commercial building sector.

Join our more than 13,000 employees who are inspired every day to deliver exceptional experiences that turn possibility into reality.

Overview

JOB DESCRIPTION:

The Program Coordinator helps keep the Business Transformation program organized and running smoothly. This role supports project teams by scheduling meetings, tracking tasks, maintaining documents, preparing communications, and helping teams stay on schedule.

Key Responsibilities

Schedule meetings and prepare agendas and materials.
Take meeting notes and track action items.
Maintain project schedules, task lists, and documentation.
Follow up with team members on deadlines and assigned work.
Create and distribute newsletters, updates, and team communications.
Organize SharePoint sites, files, and project records.
Prepare reports, presentations, and status updates.
Support onboarding, training coordination, and team events.
Manage stakeholder contact lists and communication distribution lists.
Assist project leaders with calendars, presentations, and administrative tasks.
Coordinate system access and training assignments for team members.

Qualifications

High school diploma or equivalent required.
2+ years of experience in an administrative, coordinator, office support, or customer service role.
Strong organizational and time management skills.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Experience with Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, or similar collaboration tools preferred.

Pay Range

$24.95 - $36.15

Culture And Benefits

At Andersen, we believe our people are at the heart of everything we do. Every day, their talent, dedication and passion enables us to be the most trusted window & door company. To support our employees, we provide a comprehensive Total Rewards Package – a thoughtful combination of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to investing in each team member’s wellbeing and success. While specific benefits may vary by position or location, we’re proud to offer a comprehensive Total Rewards Package designed to support your well‑being, growth, and future. Our benefits include:

401 (k) Plan, Employer Fixed Contributions & Company Matching
Profit Sharing*
Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage*
Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)*, Health Savings Account (HSA) and Health Reimbursement Account (HRA)
Life Insurance
Paid Time Off & Paid Holidays
Paid Maternity Leave & Paid Parental Leave*
Career Growth Planning & Nationwide Career Opportunities
For employees covered by a collective bargaining agreement, some benefits may differ or may not be available based on the terms of the agreement.

In 2026 Andersen has set a profit-sharing target of $3,600 per eligible employee, prorated as appropriate. Profit Sharing will be paid out in quarterly installments to provide eligible employees with payments throughout the year, with payment amounts tied to quarterly operating profit performance.
